application.javascript: document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){const form=document.getElementById('booking-form');const list=document.getElementById('booking-list');const empty=document.getElementById('empty-state');const confirmation=document.querySelector('[data-testid="booking-confirmation"]');const count=document.getElementById('booking-count');const dateInput=document.querySelector('[data-testid="booking-date"]');const today=new Date();today.setMinutes(today.getMinutes()-today.getTimezoneOffset());dateInput.min=today.toISOString().slice(0,10);let bookings=[];function render(){empty.hidden=bookings.length>0;list.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="booking"]').forEach(function(el){el.remove()});bookings.forEach(function(item){const card=document.createElement('article');card.className='booking-card'+(item.cancelled?' cancelled':'');card.dataset.testid='booking';card.dataset.status=item.cancelled?'cancelled':'active';const person=document.createElement('div');person.className='booking-person';person.dataset.testid='booking-name-display';person.textContent=item.name;const type=document.createElement('div');type.className='booking-type';type.textContent=item.type;const meta=document.createElement('div');meta.className='booking-meta';meta.textContent=formatDate(item.date)+' · '+formatTime(item.time)+'\n'+item.email;card.append(person,type,meta);if(item.cancelled){const label=document.createElement('span');label.className='cancelled-label';label.textContent='Cancelled';card.appendChild(label)}else{const button=document.createElement('button');button.className='cancel-button';button.dataset.testid='booking-cancel';button.type='button';button.textContent='Cancel';button.addEventListener('click',function(){item.cancelled=true;render()});card.appendChild(button)}list.appendChild(card)});count.textContent=bookings.filter(function(b){return !b.cancelled}).length}function formatDate(value){return new Date(value+'T00:00:00').toLocaleDateString(undefined,{month:'short',day:'numeric',year:'numeric'})}function formatTime(value){const parts=value.split(':');const d=new Date();d.setHours(parts[0],parts[1]);return d.toLocaleTimeString(undefined,{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit'})}form.addEventListener('submit',function(e){e.preventDefault();if(!form.checkValidity()){form.reportValidity();return}if(dateInput.value<dateInput.min){dateInput.setCustomValidity('Please choose today or a future date.');form.reportValidity();dateInput.setCustomValidity('');return}const data=new FormData(form);bookings.push({name:data.get('name')||document.querySelector('[data-testid="booking-name"]').value,email:data.get('email')||document.querySelector('[data-testid="booking-email"]').value,date:data.get('date')||dateInput.value,time:data.get('time')||document.querySelector('[data-testid="booking-time"]').value,type:data.get('type')||document.querySelector('[data-testid="booking-type"]').value,cancelled:false});render();confirmation.textContent='Appointment confirmed — we look forward to seeing you, '+bookings[bookings.length-1].name+'!';confirmation.hidden=false;form.reset();dateInput.min=today.toISOString().slice(0,10)});render()});
